newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Office Products upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Office Products upgraded.

text.p: -- Dean Witter Reynolds said it raised its rating on U.S. Office Products Co to buy from accumulate.
-- The firm also raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $1.05 a share from $1.00. It raised its fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.60 from $1.42.
-- In a report dated September 10, the firm set a six- to 12-month price target of $36 a share.
-- "Our sense is that our (earnings per share) estimates and (price to earnings) multiple assumption may prove to be conservative," Dean Witter said.
-- U.S. Office shares on Wednesday were down 1-1/4 at 31-3/4.
